RegistrationInfo.Description: APEX EOD window (apex-moc 2026-09-16 scheduler-not-a-service decision). Launches backend without --reload for eod_regime 16:15 ET + collect_pcr 16:30 ET; the script gates on the ET clock (16:05-16:45). The scheduler fires at local wall-clock time, an offset in StartBoundary does not fix UTC (measured 2026-11-05; the 10-19 fixed-UTC reading is retracted), so one trigger repeats every 5 min from 21:05 to 22:40 Stockholm and StartBoundary carries no offset: the repeats from 16:05 to 16:40 ET pass the guard in every regime (22:05-22:40 local in normal weeks, 21:05-21:40 in the EU/US DST-mismatch weeks) and the rest exit on it; IgnoreNew drops a repeat while an instance watches, and a launch after 16:38 ET exits on port bound (tests/test_windows_task_triggers.py). Recovery: delete this task, fall back to manual launch.
